## Privacy and collection

- Collection: disabled; enabling requires `cohort_minimum`, `consent`, `payload_allowlist`. Rollback: Stop collection and retain only approved aggregate history.
- Payload allowlist (referenced, not restated; E33-F04 names the E07 allowlist rule E07-F01 and its ingestion validation): `pending:PenniLogic/android#7`, `pending:PenniLogic/api#82`.
- Analytics consent (purpose entry in the consent ledger): `pending:PenniLogic/api#24`. Opt-out honoured: Opted-out sessions emit no event and are excluded from every denominator. Server-side opt-out enforcement (E07-F03): `pending:PenniLogic/api#63`. Study-specific research consent stays with `pending:PenniLogic/docs#65`.
- These owner choices follow the accepted threat-model records (E07, E33) and await coordinator confirmation.
- Cohort minimum, retention, aggregation and access: `pending:PenniLogic/infra#27`, `pending:PenniLogic/infra#27`, `pending:PenniLogic/infra#27`, `pending:PenniLogic/infra#27`.
- Session recording of financial or operator-sensitive content: `prohibited`.
- Privacy budget: at most 5 fields per event and 12 enumerated values per field; no free-text, number or identifier kind.
- Planted-field rejection: event names, field names and values use only the reviewed vocabulary `EVENT_VOCABULARY` in `scripts/check_ux_outcomes.py`; money, currency, raw content, prompt, identity, household, location and demographic words, and their digit-for-letter and rn/vv look-alikes, are refused by category, and a digit appears only in a journey code. Residual risk: a reviewed word can still be misused in context, so the payload review held on every event remains the backstop.

## Design-debt register

Open critical or high debt (the only debt whose release impact is `blocks_release`) blocks D8 unless the CDO-equivalent (`decision_coordinator`) records a dated, unexpired exception; `check_ux_outcomes.d8_blocking_debt` evaluates this, and open debt past its due date is reported as `readiness.debt_overdue`, on the date the check runs.

No design debt is recorded.
